name: Task Adherence
description: Composite of 5 sub-LLM-judges assessing whether the agent stayed within scope, followed instructions, respected constraints, declined out-of-scope requests, and used the right tone. Aggregates into a single adherence score.

expectedInputs.description: The user's request, ideally including any explicit constraints or boundaries.
The agent's response — judged against scope, instruction-following, tone.
Optional system message providing the agent's role / constraints to the judge.
